items.title: CVE-2026-111357: Ivanti Connect Secure local privilege escalation to root in dsinvoked broker (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Ivanti Connect Secure has a flaw in how its dsinvoked broker trusts DSCache configuration data, which lets an attacker who already has code execution as the cgi-server user escalate to root and run commands as root on the appliance. The attacker must have local access and a low-privilege login, public exploit code exists, and CISA lists the flaw as actively exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-48907: Joomla Content Editor (JCE) extension for Joomla remote code execution in editor profile management (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Joomla Content Editor (JCE) extension for Joomla has a flaw that lets an attacker create new editor profiles, upload PHP code, and run it on the server, and this can be done remotely without logging in. The vulnerability is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, which means it is being used in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-34197: Apache ActiveMQ Broker remote code execution in Jolokia MBeans (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache ActiveMQ (including the Broker and All packages) lets an attacker who can log in with a low-privilege account run arbitrary code on the broker's Java process. They reach it remotely over the network through the web console's Jolokia endpoint, by making the broker load a remote Spring XML configuration. This bug is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities c...

items.title: CVE-2023-32315: Openfire authentication bypass in admin console via path traversal (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Openfire, an XMPP server from igniterealtime, has a flaw in its web-based Admin Console that lets an attacker bypass authentication and reach restricted administrator pages by using path traversal through the setup environment. The attacker can do this remotely, without logging in, and the bug is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, meaning attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2022-0185: Linux kernel privilege escalation via heap overflow in filesystem parser (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A heap buffer overflow in the Linux kernel's filesystem context handling lets a local attacker escalate privileges to root, and container escape has also been reported. The attacker reaches it locally by opening a filesystem that falls back to legacy handling, and attacks using this flaw are happening, as it is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: CVE-2022-1096: Google Chrome memory corruption in V8 via type confusion (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Google Chrome has a type confusion flaw in its V8 engine that an attacker can reach remotely, without logging in, by getting a user to open a crafted HTML page. This can corrupt memory, and the related advisory says the worst of the bundled Chromium issues could allow remote code execution; attacks using this bug are happening, as it is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: CVE-2022-0847: Linux kernel root privilege escalation in pipe buffer handling (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Linux kernel's pipe handling leaves a pipe buffer setting uninitialized, so a local attacker with a low-privilege account can overwrite data in read-only files through the page cache and escalate privileges to root, for example by injecting code into root processes. Attacks using this bug are happening, as it is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: CVE-2026-131914: Idunno AntiCsrf remote code execution in ASP.NET CSRF token validation (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. The Idunno AntiCsrf software for ASP.NET unsafely deserializes untrusted data during its double-submit cookie and form field validation. A remote attacker can exploit this through object injection to execute code, without logging in over the network.

items.title: CVE-2026-133335
items.summary: Joomla Extension - virtuemart.net - Unauthenticated local file inclusion leading to remote code execution via controller fallback in VirtueMart extension 4.0.0-4.8.7 - The main controller of the component fell back to including a controller file derived from the request without filtering the name, allowing path traversal to arbitrary local PHP files. items.title: CVE-2026-119618: Apache HTTP Server remote code execution in mod_http2 via race condition (Update: Metasploit module published)
items.summary: Update: Metasploit module published. Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 module has a race condition in its assign_headers() routine that can corrupt heap memory. A remote attacker who can reach the server without logging in can exploit it to run arbitrary commands on the server, take control of the server process, and access or modify sensitive information. Public exploit code exists for this flaw.

items.title: CVE-2019-17382: Zabbix authentication bypass in dashboard page (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Zabbix has a flaw that lets a remote attacker bypass the login page without logging in, then create dashboards, reports, screens, or maps. Other users and administrators can then access these items. Public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2015-10141: Xdebug unauthenticated command injection in remote debugger (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Xdebug, a PHP debugging extension, has an unauthenticated command injection flaw in its remote debugger, which listens on port 9000 when remote debugging is enabled. A remote attacker without a login can send a crafted eval command to run arbitrary PHP code, including system commands, gaining full control of the host with the web server user's privileges, and public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-59309: VMware authentication bypass in VMware Directory Service (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. VMware vCenter, which is also part of products such as Cloud Foundation, vSphere Foundation, Telco Cloud Infrastructure and Telco Cloud Platform, has a flaw in its VMware Directory Service that lets an attacker bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, and public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-24061: GNU Inetutils remote authentication bypass in telnetd (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The telnetd service in GNU Inetutils can be tricked into logging an attacker in as root without a password, because it passes an unchecked USER value to the login program, which treats it as a command option. An attacker can do this remotely, without logging in, by connecting to a reachable telnetd server. Public exploit code exists, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-23131: Zabbix Frontend authentication bypass in SAML session storage (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Zabbix Frontend is affected when SAML single sign-on is enabled, which is not the default setup. An attacker can reach it remotely without logging in, change the session data, and gain admin access, as long as they know a valid Zabbix username or the guest account is enabled. It is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.title: CVE-2022-22963: Spring Cloud Function remote code execution in SpEL routing expressions (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Spring Cloud Function's routing functionality is affected by a flaw that lets an attacker run code and access local resources by sending a specially crafted SpEL routing expression, remotely and without logging in. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available, and attacks using this bug are happening.

items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. WordPress has a flaw in how it picks a page template, which lets an attacker make the site load a chosen readable PHP file from outside the theme folders. It can be reached remotely without logging in and can lead to remote code execution when certain server and theme conditions are met, and it is listed as being exploited in attacks, with public exploit code available.

Drupal is a free and open-source web content management system used by government agencies, universities, media outlets and large enterprises. The vulnerability is one of three that the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) added to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Tuesday, and federal … More → The post Critical Drupal installer flaw under active attack (CVE-2026-132165) app…

items.title: CVE-2026-134401: Google Chrome remote code execution in Variations (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Google Chrome has an input validation flaw in its Variations component. A remote attacker could use a specially crafted HTML page to potentially run arbitrary code outside the browser sandbox.

items.title: CVE-2026-132660: EnterpriseDB Postgres Enterprise Manager remote code execution via SECURITY DEFINER search path (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. EnterpriseDB's Postgres Enterprise Manager has several privileged database functions that don't use a safe search path, so a user who can connect to its backend database can plant objects that the functions use in their place. Over the network with only a low-privilege login and no user interaction, an attacker can use this to run arbitrary SQL with superuser privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-132658: EnterpriseDB Postgres Enterprise Manager privilege escalation via agent role file access (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. EnterpriseDB's Postgres Enterprise Manager gives its agent role file read and write access on the PEM server, so an attacker who controls any monitored host can read and write files on the server as the postgres operating system user. This is reachable over the network by someone with high-privilege login access, and it exposes the certificate authority key, which lets the attacker issue certif...

items.title: CVE-2017-9841: PHPUnit remote code execution in eval-stdin.php script (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. PHPUnit, a widely used testing framework for PHP, is affected by this vulnerability. An attacker can remotely run arbitrary PHP code on a server if its vendor folder is publicly accessible, potentially giving them full control of the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2024-36401: GeoServer remote code execution in property name evaluation (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. GeoServer, the open source server for sharing and editing geospatial data, has a flaw that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the host by sending crafted request parameters, remotely and without logging in. It affects default installations through web requests such as WFS, WMS and WPS calls, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.title: CVE-2017-12615: Apache Tomcat remote code execution via file upload in default servlet (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat, a widely used web server for Java applications, is affected when run on Windows with HTTP PUT requests enabled. An attacker could upload a malicious JSP file through a specially crafted request, allowing the attacker's code to run on the server.

items.title: CVE-2012-1823: PHP remote code execution in the CGI binary (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The PHP interpreter when run as a CGI program (php-cgi) is affected, along with any web server setup that uses it to handle requests. An attacker who sends a specially crafted request with command-line options in the query string could run arbitrary code on the server.

items.title: CVE-2014-6271: Remote code execution in environment variable parsing (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. GNU Bash, the common Linux and Unix command shell, runs extra commands hidden after a function definition in an environment variable's value. A remote attacker can use this to run shell commands and take over a system, without logging in, whenever a service such as an SSH, web server CGI or DHCP client setup passes attacker-controlled environment variables to Bash. This flaw is listed as exploi...

items.title: CVE-2024-27198: JetBrains TeamCity auth bypass in server login allows admin actions (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. JetBrains TeamCity has an authentication bypass flaw that lets an attacker perform administrator actions on the server. It can be exploited remotely over the network without logging in, and it is being used in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2018-14847: Unauthenticated file read in WinBox interface (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. MikroTik RouterOS has a directory traversal flaw in its WinBox interface that lets an attacker connect to the Winbox port remotely, without logging in, and read the system user database file, which exposes router credentials including plain text passwords. CISA lists this bug as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-24086: Adobe Magento Commerce remote code execution in checkout input validation (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Adobe Commerce (Magento Commerce) has an input validation flaw in its checkout process that lets an attacker run arbitrary code on the server. The attack can be carried out remotely, without logging in or any user interaction, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2023-43208: Unauthenticated code execution via command injection (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect has a flaw that lets an attacker run their own code on the server remotely, without logging in, which could be used to gain initial access or to compromise sensitive healthcare data. On Windows the code typically runs with the highest system privileges, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-20699: Cisco Small Business RV Series Router Firmware unauthenticated remote code execution in HTTP server (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Cisco Small Business RV Series Router Firmware, used on RV160, RV260, RV340 and RV345 routers, has vulnerabilities that let a remote attacker run arbitrary code with root privileges on the router by sending crafted HTTP requests, without logging in. Attacks using these flaws are happening, and exploitation is most relevant for RV340 and RV345 routers acting as an SSL VPN gateway.

items.title: CVE-2022-22954: VMware Workspace ONE Access and Identity Manager remote code execution via server-side template injection (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. VMware Workspace ONE Access and Identity Manager have a server-side template injection flaw that lets an attacker run their own code on the server. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-22965: Spring remote code execution via data binding (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Spring Framework applications using Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux on JDK 9 or later can be taken over through data binding, letting an attacker run code on the application server remotely without logging in. The known exploit needs a non-default setup, with the app deployed as a WAR on Tomcat rather than as a Spring Boot executable jar, and attacks are happening, since the bug is listed in CISA'...

items.title: CVE-2022-24112: Apache APISIX auth bypass in batch-requests plugin via X-REAL-IP (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache APISIX, through its batch-requests plugin, lets an attacker overwrite the client IP header and bypass the Admin API IP restriction, which in a default setup with the default API key leads to remote code execution; otherwise the data panel IP restriction can still be bypassed. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-24990: Unauthenticated remote code execution in web interface (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. TerraMaster NAS devices are affected by a flaw that lets an attacker run code on the device, such as uploading a PHP webshell, by abusing PHP object instantiation. It can be reached remotely without logging in, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-21882: Microsoft privilege escalation in Win32k (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Win32k component of Microsoft Windows 10 and Windows Server (including Windows Server 2019 and 2022) lets an attacker gain higher privileges than they should have. The attacker must already be able to run code on the machine with a low-privilege account, and this flaw is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-21999: Microsoft privilege escalation in print spooler service (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Windows Print Spooler service on several Microsoft Windows 10 and Windows Server releases lets an attacker raise their privileges to take much greater control of the system. The attacker must already have a low-privileged account on the machine, and no action from another user is needed. This bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-0995: Linux kernel privilege escalation via watch_queue out-of-bounds write (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Linux kernel's watch_queue event notification subsystem has an out-of-bounds memory write flaw that can overwrite kernel state, letting an attacker gain privileged access or crash the system. It is reached locally by someone who already has a low-privilege login, and it is listed by CISA as exploited in attacks.

items.summary: Am 23. November 2026 listete die Ransomware-Gruppe Safepay einen Hersteller von Förderanlagen aus Nordrhein-Westfalen auf ihrer Leak-Seite. items.title: CVE-2026-132224: Optimizely Web Experimentation attacker code injection in account signup flow (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Optimizely Web Experimentation mishandles its account signup flow, which lets an attacker place their own code in the projectJS (Project JavaScript) field of certain cdn.optimizely.com assets. An attacker can exploit this remotely over the network with a low-privilege account, and no action from a user is needed.

items.title: CVE-2026-133469
items.summary: XO (Xen Orchestra) is a solution to visualize, manage, backup and delegate your XCP-ng (or XenServer) infrastructure. Prior to 6.9.2 and 6.10.1, REST cookie parsing turns authenticationToken=j:%7B%7D into {}. REST authentication passes that object to the XO token provider without requiring a string. The token collection treats {} as an unfiltered lookup and returns its first token; the provider authenticates as that token's owner if it is unexpired. The authenticated /rest/v0/users/me/authentication_tokens route then returns reusable login token IDs. This vulnerability is actively exploited in…

items.summary: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. items.title: CVE-2026-16666 | mcu-tools MCUboot up to 1.0.0 Image Swap loader.c boot_swap_image swap_size out-of-bounds
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in mcu-tools MCUboot up to 1.0.0 . It has been classified as problematic . This affects the function boot_swap_image of the file boot/bootutil/src/loader.c of the component Image Swap . Performing a manipulation of the argument swap_size results in out-of-bounds read. This vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-16666 . The attack is only possible with local access. There is not any exploit available.

items.title: ZDI-26-1069: (0Day) BusyBox ftpd Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Read and Write Vulnerability
items.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create or delete arbitrary files or disclose sensitive information on affected installations of BusyBox. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 6.5. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-136442.

items.title: ZDI-26-1060: (0Day) Super Magic PHPSandbox Command Injection Sandbox Escape Vulnerability
items.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass the sandbox on affected installations of Super Magic. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 9.8. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-136434.

items.title: Rapid7 Analysis: VMware vCenter SRP Authentication Bypass to Root (CVE-2026-123890)

The attacker then uses that key to complete the login without knowing the account's password. The vulnerable interface is exposed through DCE/RPC on TCP port 2012. The issue, tracked as CVE-2026-123890 , combines a Secure Remote Password (SRP) session-key getter that is callable before authentication with an RPC context lookup that does not enforce ownership. The context handles use predictable UUIDv1 values. By creating two reference contexts around a…

items.title: ZDI-26-1122: (Pwn2Own) Oracle Autonomous AI Database ORDS APEX SSO Exchange Token Authentication Bypass Vulnerability

items.title: ZDI-26-1116: (Pwn2Own) Synology DiskStation DS925+ VerifySamlResponse Authentication Bypass Vulnerability

items.title: CVE-2026-128838
items.summary: The ADDRESSYA WordPress plugin through 3.1.1 does not have authorisation and CSRF checks when saving its service credentials, and does not escape them when outputting them in an admin page, allowing unauthenticated users to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-124284
items.summary: A critical security vulnerability affects certain authentication methods in Genetec Security Center, including external identity providers using OpenID Connect (OIDC) or SAML 2.0, and Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) using WS-Trust or WS-Federation. Under specific conditions, successful exploitation may allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to the system with the privileges of an affected user. Successful exploitation requires a specific combination of conditions to be met, which reduces the likelihood of a successful attack.

items.title: CVE-2026-136455
items.summary: borg-ui before 2.4.1 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows a repository-scoped operator to escalate to full administrator by exploiting an unrestricted source_directories field in the backup-plan API that lacks path allow-listing. Attackers can configure a backup plan to archive the application's data directory, download the resulting archive to extract the static HS256 .secret_key, and use it to forge a JWT with sub":"admin" to access admin-only endpoints like GET /api/auth/users, achieving full application takeover without admin credentials, XSS, or CSRF.

items.title: CVE-2026-136241
items.summary: UWAS before 0.11.16 contains a WAF bypass vulnerability in the isAPContentType() function within internal/middleware/security.go that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade SQL injection, XSS, and shell/RCE body pattern detection by setting the Content-Type header to application/json, multipart/form-data, or other exempted types. Attackers can relabel the Content-Type of malicious requests to skip WAF body scanning entirely, causing the unfiltered payload to pass through byte-for-byte to the backend application without being logged as a WAF event.

items.title: CVE-2026-136178
items.summary: Endurain before 0.20.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the PUT /api/v1/strava/link endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify Strava integrations using only a victim's strava_state value. Attackers can submit a leaked state with their own OAuth code to link an attacker-controlled Strava account, or an invalid code to remove the victim's integration.

items.title: CVE-2026-136165
items.summary: Fider before 0.40.0 contains an account takeover vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to sign in as existing users by linking OAuth identities through unverified email matches. Attackers can use a Google account carrying an unverified copy of a victim's email, including a tenant administrator's, to bind their identity via the OAuthToken handler and obtain persistent session access.

items.title: CVE-2026-136133
items.summary: NocoDB before 2026.10.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in passwordForgot() that allows unauthenticated attackers to revoke a user's sessions by requesting a password reset. items.title: CVE-2022-0778: Infinite loop in BN_mod_sqrt() reachable when parsing certificates (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Software that parses certificates, including OpenSSL and the mariadb, mysql-client, and node packages, contains an infinite loop in BN_mod_sqrt(). A remote attacker can trigger it without logging in, causing a denial of service by sending a crafted certificate, which is parsed before its signature is checked. Public exploit code is available.

items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Spreecommerce versions prior to 0.60.2 contains a remote command execution vulnerability in its search functionality. items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The application login page in AKIPS Network Monitor 15.37 through 16.5 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands via shell metacharacters in the username parameter (a failed login attempt returns the command-injection output to a limited login failure field). This is fixed in 16.6.

items.summary: Update: now rated critical. In the ARforms plugin 3.7.1 for WordPress, arf_delete_file in arformcontroller.php allows unauthenticated deletion of an arbitrary file by supplying the full pathname.

items.title: CVE-2020-15688: The HTTP Digest Authentication in the GoAhead web server before 5.1.2 does not completely protect against replay attacks (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The HTTP Digest Authentication in the GoAhead web server before 5.1.2 does not completely protect against replay attacks. This allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass authentication via capture-replay if TLS is not used to protect the underlying communication channel.

items.title: CVE-2020-21996: AVE DOMINAplus <=1.10.x suffers from an unauthenticated reboot command execution (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. AVE DOMINAplus <=1.10.x suffers from an unauthenticated reboot command execution. Attackers can exploit this issue to cause a denial of service scenario.

items.title: CVE-2021-45835: The Online Admission System 1.0 allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload or transfer files of dangerous types to the application through documents.php, which may be used to execute malicious… (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Online Admission System 1.0 allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload or transfer files of dangerous types to the application through documents.php, which may be used to execute malicious code or lead to code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-56164: Microsoft SharePoint Enterprise Server 2016 unauthenticated privilege escalation in server (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Microsoft SharePoint Server (including the 2016 Enterprise, 2019, and Subscription Edition releases) is missing an authentication check on a critical function, which lets an attacker gain higher privileges. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-21971: Microsoft Windows code execution in WinRT (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in Microsoft's Windows Runtime, which affects several Windows 10 and Windows Server releases, lets an attacker run code of their choosing on the affected system. The attacker needs local access but no login, and a user must take some action, such as opening something, to trigger it. Public exploit code exists and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-22947: Spring Cloud Gateway remote code injection in actuator endpoint (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Spring Cloud Gateway is vulnerable to code injection that lets a remote attacker run arbitrary code on the host by sending a crafted request, without logging in. This only works with a non-default setup in which the Gateway Actuator endpoint is enabled, exposed and unsecured, and public exploit code exists (including a Metasploit module) and attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-118527: Ivanti Connect Secure authenticated remote file upload via predictable filenames (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Ivanti Connect Secure has a flaw that lets an attacker who is logged in with a low-privilege account upload files with content they control to a known location on the device's disk, reaching it remotely over the network with no user interaction needed. It can be chained with other vulnerabilities, public exploit code is available, and attacks using it are happening.

items.title: CVE-2025-22457: Ivanti Connect Secure remote code execution via stack buffer overflow (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Ivanti Connect Secure, Ivanti Policy Secure, and Ivanti ZTA Gateways are affected by a stack-based buffer overflow flaw. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit it to run arbitrary code on the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2026-20045: Cisco Unified Communications Manager remote code execution in web management interface (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Cisco Unified Communications Manager, its IM and Presence Service, and Cisco Unity Connection have a flaw in how they check input in web requests, which lets an attacker run commands on the underlying operating system and gain full root control. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, through the web-based management interface, and it is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-50522: Microsoft SharePoint Enterprise Server 2016 remote code execution via unsafe deserialization (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Microsoft SharePoint Server (including the Enterprise Server 2016, Server 2019 and Subscription Edition releases) has a flaw in how it handles untrusted data, which lets an attacker run code on the SharePoint server. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in or any user action, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2021-22893: Pulse Connect Secure authentication bypass in Windows File Share Browser (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Pulse Connect Secure, a VPN gateway product, is affected through its Windows File Share Browser and Pulse Secure Collaboration features. An unauthenticated attacker could bypass login and run arbitrary code on the gateway.

items.title: CVE-2015-3306: ProFTPD access control bypass in mod_copy (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The mod_copy module in ProFTPD, an FTP server (including the Debian proftpd-dfsg package), lets an attacker copy files around on the server and possibly run arbitrary code. The attacker can do this remotely without logging in by using the "site cpfr" and "site cpto" commands. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available, and attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-20320: Cisco BroadWorks remote file read via XXE in OCI XML parser (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Cisco BroadWorks has a flaw in how its OCI-P service handles XML, letting an attacker read sensitive files, including configuration information, from the system with the privileges of the BroadWorks user. It can be exploited remotely without logging in by sending a crafted XML message, public exploit code is available, and attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-129448: Apache Roller unauthenticated code execution in XML-RPC endpoint (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Apache Roller has a deserialization flaw in its XML-RPC endpoint that lets a remote attacker run arbitrary code on the server without logging in. The endpoint deserializes vendor extension types before it checks the requester's identity.

items.title: CVE-2026-131914 — Idunno
items.summary: Idunno — Deserialization of untrusted data in double-submit cookie vs. form field validation in Idunno.AntiCsrf versions through 0.9.1 Beta on ASP.NET allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute code via object injection

items.title: CVE-2026-80273
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability. An attacker with local access to the appliance could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution and privilege escalation, resulting in complete compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the appliance.

items.title: CVE-2026-136706
items.summary: This vulnerability exists in the DIGIT Platform due to improper neutralization of user supplied input while constructing SQL queries and execution in the affected User and Access Control Service components. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending specially crafted input through the affected API endpoint to the targeted system. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries, potentially resulting in unauthorized disclosure, modification or deletion of database information on the targeted system.

items.title: CVE-2026-129968
items.summary: LiteSpeed Cache Plugin for Prestashop does not verify authenticity of "pd" parameter and uses it to render a template without checking that it is a real .tpl file. An unauthenticated attacker can send specially crafted requests to a store that cause the server to process attacker-suplied content, potentially giving the attacker full control of the store and access to customer and payment data. This issue was fixed in version 1.6.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-128857
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not restrict the source URL, destination path or file type when an unauthenticated AJAX action fetches a file and writes it to a web-accessible directory, allowing unauthenticated users to upload executable PHP files and achieve remote code execution, as well as read arbitrary local files.

items.title: CVE-2026-128854
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not validate URLs taken from the request before fetching them server-side and returning the response, allowing unauthenticated users to make the server request internal resources and read the responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-115280
items.summary: The Print Invoice & Delivery Notes for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 7.4.0 does not perform authorisation checks when rendering its front-end print document for a reserved order identifier, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the configured store contact details (including the site administrator's email address) and to create Print Invoice & Delivery Notes for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 7.4.0 files in arbitrary existing, writable directories outside the Print Invoice & Delivery Notes for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 7.4.0's own folder.

items.title: CVE-2026-134630
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the Perl Modules (cpan) module, which downloads CPAN indexes and module archives over plaintext HTTP without checksum or signature verification. On-path network attackers can answer the outbound fetch while an administrator installs a CPAN module, supplying a malicious Makefile.PL that cpan/download.cgi runs as root before confirmation.

items.title: CVE-2026-134643
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in password_change.cgi that allows unauthenticated attackers to change passwords for accounts with empty stored hashes. When passwd_mode is 2, attackers can POST user, old, new1 and new2 with any old value to set a known password and gain access.

items.title: CVE-2026-136631
items.summary: Mastodon 4.7.4 and 4.8.0-alpha.3 before 5.0.0-beta.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in authenticate_with_sign_in_token that allows authenticated local users to rebind pending login attempts to other accounts. Attackers can submit sign_in_token_resend with a victim's user[email] parameter, then guess the unthrottled 6-character token to sign in as inactive accounts lacking two-factor authentication.

items.title: CVE-2026-118898
items.summary: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in lasp-lang partisan allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to abort the Erlang VM of a node via Excessive Allocation. partisan_peer_service_server:handle_info/2 decodes every frame that arrives on the peer listener with binary_to_term/1, without the safe option, before handle_inbound/2 interprets the message and before any peer authentication takes place. TLS is off by default and the listener accepts connections from any host, so one frame that names more atoms than the atom table holds aborts the VM. partisan_peer_service_client:handle_inf…

items.title: CVE-2026-136626
items.summary: SRS 4.0.0 before 6.0.194, 7.0.0 before 7.0.214, and 8.0.0 before 8.0.73 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in SrsRtcpCommon::decode and SrsRtcpTWCC::decode that lets remote WebRTC peers write past the fixed 1500-byte payload_ array. Unauthenticated attackers opening a WHIP or WHEP session can send oversized BYE, APP, unknown-type or TWCC RTCP packets to overwrite up to 64 KB of heap memory, crashing the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-134648
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a header directive injection vulnerability in sendmail/autoreply.pl that allows unauthenticated mail senders to inject autoreply directives by placing them in inbound subject, from, date, or body fields. Attackers can inject Reply-Tracking to delete files at chosen paths, Autoreply-File to exfiltrate files readable by the delivery user, or arbitrary reply headers including To.

items.title: CVE-2026-134644
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a path traversal vulnerability in minecraft/minecraft-lib.pl that allows unauthenticated game players to overwrite arbitrary files as root via crafted chat messages. Attackers can send chat messages mimicking logged in lines so the root check_playtime_limits cron job rewrites attacker-chosen files, destroying their contents.

items.title: CVE-2026-134642
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in fastrpc.cgi that allows unauthenticated network peers to connect to tcpwrite and tcpread file-transfer listeners without session checks. Attackers can race to connect to the predictable transfer port during cluster operations to steal transferred files or replace staged packages, achieving root code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-134447
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in postfix/view_mailq.cgi and sendmail/view_mailq.cgi that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script via unsanitized MIME attachment filenames. Attackers can send a message with a crafted Content-Disposition or Content-Type filename that remains queued, executing script in the Webmin session of users viewing it.

items.title: CVE-2026-134340
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Servers Index module that allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to inject scripts via the realhost field of UDP discovery replies. Attackers on the same broadcast domain can answer discovery scans with HTML or JavaScript stored by find_servers() and rendered unescaped by edit_serv.cgi, executing in Webmin user sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134336
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts by submitting malicious failed-login usernames. Attackers can repeatedly submit crafted usernames until blocked, executing script in administrator sessions viewing edit_blocked.cgi in Webmin or Usermin.

items.title: CVE-2026-134328
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in mailboxes/detach.cgi that allows unauthenticated mail senders to bypass the HTML sanitizer. Attackers can send HTML attachments with entity-obfuscated javascript: schemes or encoded script tags in iframe srcdoc to execute script in the Webmin session of users opening them.

items.title: CVE-2026-134304
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in apache/restart.cgi that displays the last five Apache ErrorLog lines without HTML escaping. Unauthenticated attackers can inject script into error_log via malformed requests or denied paths, executing in a Webmin user's session when Apache fails to restart.

items.title: CVE-2026-136630
items.summary: Electerm before 5.9.0 contains an origin validation vulnerability in the MCP Server widget that allows remote attackers to execute commands by bypassing Host and Origin checks through DNS rebinding. Attackers can lure users to a page that rebinds to 127.0.0.1 and calls unauthenticated MCP tools on port 30837 to run OS commands locally and on open SSH sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-136622
items.summary: WeKan before 12.78 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in Exporter.buildStream() that lets attackers retrieve checklists from other boards by supplying a checklistId export scope. Users able to export any board, or unauthenticated users via a public board, can read private checklists, their items and creator usernames even when anonymization is enabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-128856
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not restrict the file paths, extensions or contents written by one of its unauthenticated AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to write arbitrary PHP files to a web-accessible directory and execute code on the server.

items.title: CVE-2026-128855
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not validate a user-supplied file path before deleting it, allowing unauthenticated users to delete image and PDF files anywhere the web server can write, including the whole media library.

items.title: CVE-2026-128853
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, allowing unauthenticated users to perform SQL injection attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-128852
items.summary: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not validate the type or content of files uploaded through several unauthenticated AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to store SVG files containing JavaScript, which are served from the site's own origin and executed in the browser of any user who opens them, such as an administrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-125896
items.summary: The Synoptic Web Designer: best WordPress design tool WordPress plugin through 1.12 does not perform any capability, authentication, or nonce check on an action that is also exposed to unauthenticated visitors, and it builds a database UPDATE statement by concatenating unvalidated request input, allowing unauthenticated attackers to overwrite arbitrary database records, including an administrator's password, and take over the site. This is only exploitable on PHP 7.x.

items.title: CVE-2026-134639
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an insecure default configuration in its Windows setup.bat script that provisions an administrator account with the credentials admin/admin and SSL disabled. Unauthenticated network attackers can log in over plain HTTP on port 10000 with these unchanged credentials to gain full Webmin administrative access.

items.title: CVE-2026-136627
items.summary: SRS 4.0.0 before 6.0.194, 7.0.0 before 7.0.214, and 8.0.0 before 8.0.73 contains a reachable assertion in RTCP decoding that lets remote WebRTC peers crash the server. Attackers opening an unauthenticated WHIP or WHEP session can send an 8-byte RTCP packet with undersized length, triggering srs_assert aborts that stop every stream.

items.title: CVE-2026-136623
items.summary: WeKan before 12.78 contains an access control bypass in Exporter.buildCsvStream() that ignores the Disable all export and Anonymize export users settings. Board readers or unauthenticated users of public boards can request the CSV export endpoint to export all cards and reveal real usernames in member, assignee, and mention fields.

Attackers can send POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE requests to /api/v1/tournaments to create, modify or delete tournaments, cascading deletion to teams and speakers.

items.title: CVE-2026-135428
items.summary: Automura for Gravity Forms – Webhooks & REST API for Automation before 1.0.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in Rest_Admin::serve_file() on the global rest_pre_serve_request filter. Unauthenticated attackers can craft REST links setting automura_gf_file to script HTML and automura_gf_file_type to text/html, executing JavaScript with a victim administrator's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-103789
items.summary: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains a heap based buffer overflow. An unauthenticated remote attacker with adjacent network access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to a denial of service condition.

items.title: CVE-2026-135260
items.summary: MISP contains multiple flaws in its login and one-time-password (OTP) brute-force lockout mechanism that collectively weaken authentication protection. - Lockout counter bypass: the lockout stored and matched usernames using a single-byte case-fold function. An email address containing a non-ASCII capital letter (for example a Latin-1 or Cyrillic uppercase) was never counted toward the lockout threshold, allowing unlimited failed login attempts against that account. - Collation-folding authentication bypass: the database collation performs accent and width folding, so a Unicode variant of a va…

items.title: CVE-2026-135211
items.summary: BISHENG before 3.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the /api/v2/workflow/invoke and /api/v2/workflow/stop routes that allows unauthenticated attackers to run workflows as the administrator. Attackers knowing a workflow UUID can supply an override replacing a Code node's code parameter with Python passed to exec(), achieving remote code execution, or stop other users' workflow sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-82981
items.summary: SQL injection in WHMCS could allow an unauthenticated user to retrieve clients' personal and support information, as well as administrator account records and password hashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-129837
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by sending a specially crafted log message with an unusual timestamp. When the service processes this message using weekday formatting templates, an out-of-bounds memory read occurs, causing the application to crash.

items.title: CVE-2026-132779
items.summary: When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use TLS 1.3 early data using the ssl_early_data on directive, an attacker can use a specially crafted TLS 1.3 connection to drive an NGINX worker into a tight loop in which it repeatedly retries the same send without ever making progress. The worker continues accepting new connections and handling existing ones, but one CPU core is pinned at 100%. Impact: System performance can degrade until the NGINX worker process is either forced to restart or is manually restarted. This vulnerability may allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause a degr…

items.title: CVE-2026-135208
items.summary: Kerberos Agent before 3.14.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens because JWTMiddleWare() falls back to the hard-coded key TOBECHANGED. Attackers can sign HS256 tokens with arbitrary username and role claims to access /api and /config routes, exposing RTSP, ONVIF, Hub and encryption keys, rewriting configuration, and stopping the camera.

items.title: CVE-2026-135244
items.summary: MISP trusted client-supplied forwarded IP headers (such as X-Forwarded-For) without verifying that the request originated from a known proxy or that the value was a valid IP address. The configured header value was accepted as the authoritative client IP for all security-relevant functions. An unauthenticated remote attacker could forge the forwarded header to: - Bypass IP-based restrictions on API authentication keys - Evade brute-force / rate-limiting protection - Inject arbitrary values into application and ECS logs, corrupting audit trails The vulnerability required the MISP.log_client_ip_…

items.title: CVE-2026-95455
items.summary: In ServerSessionBroker of server_session_broker.cc, there is a possible use after free due to a race condition. This could lead to remote code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

items.title: CVE-2026-95449
items.summary: In NexustalkStream::PullFrameTask of nexustalk_stream.cc, there is a possible use after free due to a race condition. This could lead to remote code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is needed for exploitation.

items.title: CVE-2026-95448
items.summary: In MediaFocusFidlImpl of media_focus_fidl_impl.cc, there is a possible use after free due to a race condition. This could lead to remote code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

items.title: CVE-2026-95433
items.summary: In FuchsiaVideoOutputProvider of fuchsia_video_output_provider.cc, there is a possible use after free due to a race condition. This could lead to remote code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is needed for exploitation.

items.title: CVE-2026-135293
items.summary: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in icmp_in() in os/net/ipv6/multicast/mpl.c that allows unauthenticated attackers to hang nodes via crafted MPL control messages. Attackers on the same link can send an MPL data message to create a seed entry, then an all-zero bit vector control message causing index wraparound and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-135292
items.summary: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the MPL multicast engine that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to corrupt memory via unchecked seed ID lengths. Attackers can send near-maximum-size MPL messages with an S=3 option in a short hop-by-hop header, causing data_message_expiration() to write 16 bytes past uip_buf and crash the node.

items.title: CVE-2026-135286
items.summary: phpwcms before 1.9.53, 1.12.7 and 2.0.0-beta.4 contains a host header poisoning vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to control password reminder links by sending a forged X-Forwarded-Host header. Attackers can submit the public password reminder form for a victim so the emailed {LOGIN_URL} points to an attacker host, capturing the new password when the victim logs in there.

items.title: CVE-2026-129976
items.summary: Memory Allocation with Excessive Size Value (CWE-789) in Packetbeat can lead to denial of service via a specially crafted, malformed Cassandra protocol message. An unauthenticated attacker who can send traffic on a network segment that Packetbeat monitors can cause Packetbeat to allocate excessive memory and terminate. Elastic Agent is also affected when the Network Packet Capture integration monitors Cassandra traffic, because it uses the same protocol decoder.

Brotli and zstd, with their high compression ratios, made the attack particularly effective. items.summary: The DINA-community icsnpp-mms 1.0.0 plugin for Zeek does not release partially decoded Manufacturing Message Specification (MMS) protocol data units when ASN.1 Basic Encoding Rules (BER) decoding fails. items.title: Machine-Generated Fake Plugin Turns WordPress Sites Into JavaScript Delivery Points
items.summary: The Wordfence Threat Intelligence Team recently analyzed a malware campaign that installs a fake WordPress plugin built almost entirely by a name generator. Various identifiers in the project - the plugin title, its directories and files, its PHP functions, variables and REST namespaces - are a machine-made compound of a prefix, a technology word and a suffix: trijavascriptly, ultravueal, maxdataic-quaddatasion. EnterpriseDB's Postgres Enterprise Manager fails to restrict each monitoring agent to its own jobs, so an attacker who controls one monitored host and its agent certificate can create, change or delete jobs for every other agent, including the one on the PEM server. Because agents run SQL job steps with the database credentials of the server they monitor (and shell steps where batch jobs are en...

items.title: CVE-2026-99310: Linux kernel use-after-free in NFSD open owner tracking (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A use-after-free flaw in the Linux kernel's NFS server (nfsd) lets an attacker corrupt kernel memory and crash the system, and the advisory's scoring also rates the impact on data confidentiality and integrity as high. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, by sending NFSv4.1 EXCHANGE_ID requests with mismatched credentials while the client's open owner is being freed, and public explo...

items.title: CVE-2024-4577: PHP code execution via argument injection in CGI (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. PHP's CGI module, used with Apache on Windows, is affected when the system uses certain code pages. An attacker could exploit this to pass unintended options to the PHP binary, potentially exposing script source code or running arbitrary PHP code on the server.

items.title: CVE-2022-33891: Apache Spark OS command injection in web UI (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Spark, a widely used open-source data processing framework, is affected when its web UI has access control lists enabled and an authentication filter in use. An attacker could exploit this flaw to run arbitrary operating system commands with the same privileges as the Spark process, potentially taking full control of the affected server.

items.title: CVE-2026-31431: Linux kernel memory corruption in algif_aead AEAD sockets (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Linux kernel's AF_ALG user-space cryptography interface, specifically its AEAD (authenticated encryption) socket implementation in the algif_aead module, is affected. The flaw was introduced by an earlier in-place operation change, and the fix reverts that approach, which addresses incorrect handling of memory operations and could lead to memory corruption or unintended data behavior in aff...

items.title: CVE-2024-3273: D-Link DNS-320L remote command execution in nas_sharing.cgi (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Attackers can run their own commands on D-Link DNS-320L, DNS-325, DNS-327L and DNS-340L network storage devices by sending a crafted web request to the nas_sharing.cgi page, remotely and without logging in. These models are no longer supported by the vendor, and the flaw is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2022-0543: Debian redis sandbox escape in Lua scripting enables code execution (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Debian's packaged build of Redis, the key-value database, has a flaw that lets an attacker escape the Lua sandbox and run arbitrary shell commands, reachable remotely without logging in by someone who can run Lua code in Redis. This bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-134624: N-able MailAssure server-side request forgery in relay LDAP sync check (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. N-able MailAssure's relay LDAP synchronisation connection check does not restrict its destination, which enables a server-side request forgery flaw. An attacker who can log in with high-level access can reach it remotely over the network to make the server connect to internal hosts and ports, find which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

items.title: CVE-2026-111793: Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder file type restriction bypass in file conversion (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Openwave Messaging's Webtop Media Transcoder does not enforce the file type restrictions set by administrators, so an authenticated user can convert document types that were meant to be blocked. An attacker reaches it over the network with a low-privilege login, by bypassing the Webmail interface and going to the transcoder directly, and attacks using this flaw are happening.

items.title: CVE-2025-42884: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal remote data exposure via JNDI injection (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal has a JNDI injection flaw that lets an attacker steer the software to an unintended JNDI provider, which could expose or alter information about the server. It can be exploited remotely, without logging in or any user interaction, and it is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.title: CVE-2026-111560: Barracuda Networks root command injection in timezone field (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Several Barracuda Networks appliances, including the Email Security Gateway, Load Balancer ADC, Web Application Firewall, Web Security Gateway, Message Archiver and WAF Control Center, have a flaw in the timezone setting that lets an attacker inject operating system commands that run with root privileges. The attacker must reach the appliance over the network and log in as an administrator, and...

items.summary: arXiv:2611.31949v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While malware on platforms such as Windows and Android has been extensively studied, the macOS ecosystem remains comparatively understudied. To address this gap, we present MALET, a large-scale public dataset for macOS malware analysis. MALET contains 44{,}804 malicious Mach-O binaries and 44{,}457 samples with zero antivirus detections on VirusTotal. From the undetected set, we further identify 25{,}835 high-confidence benign samples using conservative, heuristic-based filtering. We also introduce Katalina, an open-source static analysis framewo…

items.title: SoK: Splitting the Trigger or Adding Attackers? Disentangling Distributed Backdoor Attacks in Federated Learning
items.summary: arXiv:2611.28491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distributed backdoor attacks split a trigger among several federated learning clients, so that the backdoor appears only in the aggregated model. Since DBA, a line of work has reported that such attacks are stronger, more persistent, and stealthier than a single attacker with the full trigger. We systematize this literature and test this belief. We code nineteen primary studies and fifteen papers that evaluate against DBA. The reported advantage is rarely measured against a complete trigger delivered by the same attackers, and none of the fifteen…

items.summary: arXiv:2611.28825v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Static malware detectors that represent each sample as a bag of extracted features, such as permissions, API calls, or imported functions, are cheap to deploy and remain state-of-the-art under temporal drift and in selective classification. Yet, attackers can evade them by adding benign-looking content that outweighs malicious evidence. Canonically, detectors encode the presence of a few thousand features, selected during training, as sparse multi-hot vectors over a fixed vocabulary. Features that emerge after training remain invisible. We show t…

items.title: CVE-2026-135768
items.summary: A flaw was found in the keycloak-services component of Keycloak, which is used for managing authentication and authorization flows. The issue occurs when a client policy is configured to enforce a high-assurance authentication flow requiring OTP. Due to improper validation of existing sessions, a lower-assurance password-only SSO session can be incorrectly accepted if the request does not explicitly demand a specific assurance level. This allows an attacker with access to a user's password or session to bypass the second factor and obtain tokens claiming a higher level of security.

items.title: CVE-2026-133461
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.10.0, the OAuth authorize endpoint redirects to unvalidated error redirect targets. An attacker can craft a link on the platform's own domain that redirects a signed-in user to an attacker-controlled site, which can present a lookalike consent or sign-in page to harvest credentials. This issue is fixed in version 0.10.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-136190
items.summary: RayLabsHQ gitea-mirror before 3.38.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the /api/sso/providers handlers that allows any authenticated user to access other users' SSO providers without ownership checks. items.title: CVE-2026-132264
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.63 through 0.10.0, an external API key or OAuth token that has only the EXECUTE_BLOCK permission can run AutoPilotBlock through the external API and receive a full, unattended AutoPilot turn. This lets the holder use the account owner's stored third-party credentials, library agents, and workspace files, and run AutoPilot's sandboxed shell, which the same key is refused when it requests those directly. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-135798

items.title: CVE-2026-129317
items.summary: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.41 through 0.11.1, the OAuth provider endpoints check a calling application's client secret against a scrypt hash synchronously on the REST API event loop. Anyone who knows the client ID of an active confidential OAuth application can stall the REST API for all users by sending a stream of requests with a wrong secret. No account or token is required. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-132257

items.title: CVE-2026-133775
items.summary: The fix for CVE-2026-55877 (GHSA-6v8j-33hc-mv84) sanitizes the SVG of icons before they are rendered inline. It removes scripts and event handlers everywhere, except inside elements. Unlike in HTML, the content of an SVG element is parsed as markup. An icon can therefore still run JavaScript in the page with, for example: alert(1) Applications are exposed when an attacker can influence the SVG of the icons they render. items.title: CVE-2026-133744
items.summary: The fixes for CVE-2026-135804 (GHSA-cpww-5vpx-72x7) bound the regex work of a JsonCrawler::find() call, and evaluate filters and absolute queries once per call. items.title: CVE-2026-136229
items.summary: When a signed OpenPGP/MIME message had no Date header, or one that could not be parsed, Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date. For S/MIME messages with more than one Date header, a later Date header could be used for the comparison. An attacker who had an old signed message could resend it and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-136228
items.summary: Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date for messages that were both signed and encrypted with OpenPGP/MIME. An attacker who had an old signed message could encrypt it to the victim and resend it with a current date, and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-136228
items.summary: Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date for messages that were both signed and encrypted with OpenPGP/MIME. An attacker who had an old signed message could encrypt it to the victim and resend it with a current date, and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-136229
items.summary: When a signed OpenPGP/MIME message had no Date header, or one that could not be parsed, Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date. For S/MIME messages with more than one Date header, a later Date header could be used for the comparison. An attacker who had an old signed message could resend it and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161.

items.title: CVE-2026-114713: UnrealIRCd remote command injection in labeled-response module (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. The labeled-response module in UnrealIRCd 6.0.0 (before the 6.2.7.1 fix) fails to escape the IRCv3 "label" message tag, so any user on a network with two or more linked servers can, remotely and without logging in, inject server-to-server commands that run with server authority. Because the bug requires a network with at least two linked servers, it is not limited to a single standalone server.

items.title: CVE-2020-11652: SaltStack Salt path traversal in master server file handling (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. SaltStack Salt's salt-master process has a flaw in how it cleans up file paths, which lets an attacker who has a low-privilege login read arbitrary directories on the salt master. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network with no user interaction, and the bug is listed as exploited in attacks by CISA.

items.title: CVE-2025-68461: Roundcube Webmail cross-site scripting via SVG animate tag (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Roundcube Webmail has a cross-site scripting flaw that lets an attacker run their own script in a victim's browser within the Roundcube webmail page, by supplying an SVG document with an animate tag that the HTML sanitizer fails to block. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, and attacks using it are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-133761

Each row also builds all the levels of its headers again. With a deep header, a CSV body of 2 KB made of short rows allocates more than 128 MB. items.title: CVE-2026-133757
items.summary: Since Symfony 5.4.48, 6.4.16, 7.1.9 and 7.2.0, NoPrivateNetworkHttpClient follows redirects itself, and sends each hop as a new request through the client it decorates. Before a redirect to another origin, it removes the Authorization and Cookie headers it knows about. But the decorated client then added its own default options again. These include the auth_basic, auth_bearer and auth_ntlm credentials, and the Authorization and Cookie headers it was created with. Credentials set with withOptions() on the decorator came back the same way, since the decorator forwards them to the decorated clien…

items.title: CVE-2026-133755
items.summary: Since Symfony 7.3, the require_tls option of EsmtpTransport refuses to send a message over a connection that isn't encrypted. It prevents a network attacker from stripping STARTTLS. But after the server's 220 reply to STARTTLS, the transport started the TLS handshake without checking whether more data had already arrived. An attacker in the middle of the connection could add cleartext replies right after the 220. The transport then read them as if they came from the encrypted session. The attacker could make the transport skip AUTH, or report a message as sent while the server had rejected it.…

items.summary: UrlGenerator puts the values of host placeholders into the generated URL without encoding them. Their default requirement, [^.]++, accepts /, @, #, ?, \, % and :. With the host {tenant}.example.com, the value evil%2Ecom# gives https://evil%2Ecom#.example.com/dashboard, which browsers send to evil.com. This works even when requirements are checked. Unicode full stops like 。 have the same effect, since IDNA maps them to .. It did that for the requested class, but wrote into another class in two cases. The first case is the class that a discriminator map picks from the data. The transport then sent the sender, the recipients and the whole message in cleartext, and reported success. No AUTH command is sent on that path, so credentials don't leak. Connections that…

Its withOptions() method passes the options to the decorated client only. So credentials set with withOptions(), like auth_bearer, auth_basic, an Authorization header or a Cookie header, reach the server, but CachingHttpClient doesn't see them. They're missing from the cache key. They also miss the rule that keeps a shared cache from storing the responses to requests with an Authorization header. items.title: CVE-2026-133749
items.summary: GuardAuthenticatorHandler::authenticateUserAndHandleSuccess() logs a user in programmatically with a Guard authenticator, for example in the registration controllers that MakerBundle generated. This method creates the token and stores it, but it calls neither checkPreAuth() nor checkPostAuth() on the user checker of the firewall. Guard authenticators run both checks when they authenticate a request. As a consequence, an account that a user checker rejects in checkPostAuth() could still be logged in through this method, for example an expired account. Applications are affected when they use Gua…
